sync_rules: Check all 3 platforms for listing status of each skill
Update any platform where listing is missing or outdated
Sync pricing changes across all platforms
Update SKILL.md and manifest files if needed
github_action:
name: Sync Skill Catalog
on:
  schedule: [{cron: '0 */6 * * *'}]
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pip install clawhub
      - run: python sync_skills.py
